properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 1 at 12:17AM MDT until September 1 at 3:00AM MDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Cheyenne County in east central Colorado...
Southwestern Kit Carson County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 300 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1217 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Cheyenne Wells, Kit Carson, Firstview, Wild Horse and Aroya.
